title: SIDESTORY: WHEN ELEGIES ARE ASHES RERUN
lines: 01 SIDESTORY: WHEN ELEGIES ARE ASHES RERUN
DURATION: August 27, 2026, 04:00 – September 10, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
UNLOCK REQUIREMENT: Clear Main Storyline 1-10
DETAILS: When Elegies Are Ashes event stages will be open for a limited time. Players can obtain event rewards by clearing event stages, completing event missions, and redeeming from Event Store.
EVENT STAGE DURATION:
[Flickering Shadows] & [Dying Flames]
DURATION: August 27, 2026, 04:00 – September 6, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
[Griefs yet to Relieve]
DETAILS: During the event, players can complete [Griefs yet to Relieve] missions by clearing event stages to gain rewards.
REWARDS: [★★★★★: Brigid], 'Night of Na Saoirsí' Furniture (Pieces), Module Materials, [Broken Originium Lamp], etc.
[Lives Yet to Begin]
DURATION: August 27, 2026, 04:00 – September 10, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)

DETAILS: During the event, players can obtain [Broken Originium Lamp] by clearing event stages and completing [Griefs yet to Relieve] missions. [Broken Originium Lamp] can be used to redeem items from [Lives Yet to Begin].
REWARDS: Brigid's token, 'Night of Na Saoirsí' Furniture (Pieces), Headhunting Permit, Elite Materials, LMD, Battle Records, etc.
Note:

- For this rerun event, some of the engraved medals in the corresponding Engraved Medal Set will have their acquisition conditions adjusted. Players who meet the updated conditions will be able to obtain the event's engraved medals. Due to these adjustments, players who previously participated in the event and already meet the new acquisition conditions will receive the corresponding engraved medals immediately upon the update.
- After this rerun event ends, the engraved medals from the event's Engraved Medal Set cannot be obtained through [Score] or any other channels.
- This rerun event is a lightweight rerun; event stages will inherit the player's previous event stage progress and first-time drop progress.

- Some non-repeatable event rewards during this rerun can be converted into [Intelligence Certificate] at a corresponding ratio when obtained again. The conversion rates can be found in the event's Intelligence Certificate Conversion Rules.
- The [Intelligence Certificate] shop will restock additional quantities of existing items and add new items when the event starts.
- Trust gain for Necrass, Wulfenite, and Brigid will be increased in the event stages of this rerun.
- After this event ends, the event stages will be permanently added to [Score] on September 10, 2026, at 04:00 (UTC-7).
02 LIMITED-TIME HEADHUNTING RERUN – RETURNED FROM A PYRE
DURATION: August 27, 2026, 08:00 – September 10, 2026, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, the Limited-time Headhunting, [Returned From A Pyre], opens and the following Operators will appear at a higher rate:
★★★★★★: Necrass
★★★★★: Wulfenite / Warmy

Note: This is a [Standard Headhunting] that features the same Operators as the latest permanent [Standard Headhunting]. If you make 150 headhunting attempts without receiving the current rate-up 6-star Operator, the next 6-star Operator received is guaranteed to be the current rate-up 6-star Operator.'
